description: TECH PUBLIC (taizhou/sot23.com.tw) TPD4E1U06DBVR quad-channel high-speed ESD protection device, 4-page datasheet. Uni-directional TVS diode array: each protected I/O has a diode to an internal rail and a diode to GND, with a single zener from the rail to GND (steering-diode + rail-clamp topology). Features as printed: ultra low capacitance 0.6 pF typical I/O to GND, ultra low leakage nA level, low operating voltage 5.5 V, low clamping voltage. Complies with IEC 61000-4-2 (ESD immunity, air +/-20 kV, contact +/-15 kV), IEC 61000-4-5 (lightning) 3.3 A (8/20 us), IEC 61000-4-4 (EFT) 80 A (5/50 ns). RoHS compliant, lead finish matte tin, green molding compound, UL 94V-0, MSL Level 3 per J-STD-020. Marking NG4P. 3000 pcs per 7 inch reel.

pinout.name: D2-
pinout.notes: Protected channel (bottom row, leftmost in the top view of the pin-configuration drawing).

pinout.name: GND
pinout.notes: Ground / clamp return. The only ground pin; all four channels clamp to it.

pinout.name: D2+
pinout.notes: Protected channel. Pairs with D2- (pin 1) as one differential channel pair in the datasheet's internal schematic ordering D1+, D1-, D2+, D2-.

pinout.name: D1+
pinout.notes: Protected channel (top row, rightmost in the top view).

pinout.name: NC
pinout.notes: No connect. Explicitly labelled NC in the Dimensions and Pin Configuration drawing; it is NOT a protected channel and NOT a ground.

land_pattern.notes: From the page-4 'Land Pattern - SOT23-6' drawing and table (millimetre column): P = 0.95 pitch, X = 0.60 pad width, Y = 1.10 pad length, G = 1.40 gap between the two pad rows, Z = 3.60 overall span across the rows, C = 2.50 pad-centre to pad-centre row spacing. Self-consistent: Z = G + 2Y = 3.60 and C = G + Y = 2.50. Package outline (separate drawing, same page): D 2.80/2.90/3.00 body length, E1 1.50/1.60/1.75 body width, E 2.80 BSC lead span, e 0.95 BSC, e1 1.90 BSC, A 0.90/-/1.45 height, A1 0.00/-/0.15 standoff, A2 0.90/1.15/1.30, b 0.25/-/0.50 lead width, c 0.08/-/0.22 lead thickness, L 0.30/0.45/0.60, N = 6, theta1 0 to 10 deg. Pins 1,2,3 on one row and 4,5,6 on the opposite row (pin 1 bottom-left, pin 6 top-left in the drawing's top view).

layout_notes: This datasheet contains NO layout-guidance section - no routing, stub-length, ground-return or placement advice is published by the vendor for this part.

Topology fact usable for placement (from the internal schematic on page 1): all four channels return to the single GND pin (pin 2), so the GND pin is the common clamp return and wants the shortest, lowest-inductance path to the reference plane.

Pin 5 is NC, so the pin-4 / pin-6 (D1+/D1-) pair sits on either side of an unconnected pin, while the pin-1 / pin-3 (D2-/D2+) pair straddles the GND pin - relevant when mapping a 100 ohm differential pair onto the part.
